title: The Gallery Painting Switch
incident: A masterwork by Caravaggio ('The Penitent Saint') valued at $35M was discovered to be an acrylic replica. The switch took place sometime during the previous 24 hours. The frame humidity sensor recorded an anomalous spike at 3:15 AM, yet security sensors showed no perimeter breach.
centralQuestions: When was the canvas detached from the antique stretcher?
How did an acrylic replica bypass the UV inspection lamp?
Who had access to the master restorers' elevator during the overnight lockup?

timeline.event: Gallery closes to public; curator performs routine evening walk.
Restoration team completes varnish drying cycle on adjacent room.
Microclimate humidity sensor behind painting spikes from 48% to 62%.
Night guard shifts rotate; master keycard handed to relief guard.
Visiting art appraiser tests canvas with UV light and detects synthetic pigment.

suspects.name: Gianna Rossi
suspects.motive: Facing bankruptcy of family gallery foundation.
suspects.statement: She claims she left at 6:30 PM and attended an art gala.
relevant_evidence: Gala photos confirm presence until 1:00 AM.
supporting_evidence: Photo with city mayor at 12:45 AM.
suspicious_evidence: Gala was only 15 minutes away from the gallery.
suspects.uncertainty: Her whereabouts between 1:30 AM and 6:00 AM are uncorroborated.

suspects.name: Matteo Bianchi
suspects.motive: Underpaid artisan with technical ability to create indistinguishable copies.
suspects.statement: He says he stayed until 11:00 PM finishing adjacent varnish work.
relevant_evidence: Synthetic acrylic mediums matching the replica found in his personal kit.
supporting_evidence: Security gate log confirms exit at 11:05 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Carried a large portfolio case through the gate.
suspects.uncertainty: Restorers routinely transport blank canvases and pigments.
open_questions: Did he re-enter using service keys?

suspects.name: Silvio Dante
suspects.motive: Brokered acquisition for an anonymous offshore buyer.
suspects.statement: He says he never stepped foot into the gallery after hours.
relevant_evidence: Wire transfer of $2M deposited in his Swiss holding company yesterday.
supporting_evidence: Hotel room keycard shows continuous occupancy from 10 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Was seen arguing with Gianna Rossi yesterday morning.
suspects.uncertainty: Financial transactions do not prove physical commission of burglary.
open_questions: Did he hire an inside operative?

suspects.name: Paolo Ricci
suspects.motive: Severe gambling debts with local syndicate.
suspects.statement: He says he was monitoring CCTV screens in the control booth.
relevant_evidence: CCTV log shows 3:00-3:30 AM footage of gallery room 4 was a frozen looped tape.
suspicious_evidence: Control console shows the camera freeze command originated from his terminal.
suspects.uncertainty: He lacks the delicate technical skill to slice an antique canvas from its stretcher.
open_questions: Was he acting as an accomplice for someone else?

witnesses.name: Appraiser Dr. Fontana
witnesses.statement: The replica is extraordinarily high quality—painted within the last 30 days using aged varnish.
witnesses.limitations: Cannot date the wooden frame swap.

witnesses.name: Relief Guard Bruno
witnesses.statement: When I arrived at 4:00 AM, Paolo looked nervous and spilled his espresso on the desk.
witnesses.limitations: Did not enter room 4 until morning.

evidence.title: Microclimate Humidity Log
evidence.description: Display sensor recorded humidity jump at 3:15 AM consistent with warm human breath and open casement.
evidence.establishes: The case was breached at precisely 3:15 AM.

evidence.title: CCTV Loop Injection Log
evidence.description: Room 4 camera video stream was manually overridden with an 8-minute still loop from 3:12 AM to 3:20 AM.
evidence.establishes: The night guard station deliberately obscured camera footage during the theft.

evidence.title: Synthetic Pigment Residue
evidence.description: Phthalo green acrylic residue found on cutting scalpel in restoration lab.
evidence.establishes: Replica was trimmed with this scalpel.
evidence.does_not_establish: Whose fingerprints were on the handle.

evidence.title: Curator Parking Toll Record
evidence.description: Gianna Rossi's vehicle entered the municipal garage adjacent to gallery at 2:50 AM.
evidence.establishes: Gianna Rossi was physically adjacent to the gallery at 3:15 AM.

evidence.title: Encrypted WhatsApp Transcript
evidence.description: Text message on Paolo's phone: 'Tape loops at 3:10. Bring the tube.'
evidence.establishes: Conspiracy between Paolo and an outside actor.

redHerrings: Matteo's late departure with the portfolio case was suspicious, but security footage at 11:05 AM shows his portfolio contained architectural sketches for the next hall.
Silvio Dante's wire transfer was legitimate proceeds from an auction in Florence.

hiddenSolution.explanation: Gianna Rossi, facing bankruptcy, contracted an illicit buyer through Silvio's contacts. She commissioned a replica weeks in advance, paid guard Paolo Ricci to freeze the camera loop at 3:12 AM, parked at 2:50 AM, entered via curator key, swapped the canvas, and rolled the original into a carrying tube.
decisiveEvidence: E-D (Gianna's car parked next door at 2:50 AM)
uncertainties: Exact current location of the original canvas
Identity of the ultimate black-market purchaser
hiddenSolution.alternativeExplanation: Matteo Bianchi hid inside the building past 11:00 PM and executed the switch while Paolo was asleep.

missingEvidence: Traffic cameras along the boulevard between 3:30 and 4:00 AM
rules: A frozen camera tape proves insider tampering, not the identity of the physical thief.
Circumstantial presence near a building requires corroboration with internal access events.
